title: Add VPC control plane Terraform: subnets, endpoints, security groups, peering, Route53 modules
author: Priya Shah
description: Adds opinionated Terraform modules and example stacks to provision the Private Control Plane VPC components used by on-prem/VPC deployments. Motivation: customers deploying Private need a repeatable, secure VPC layout with private endpoints, minimal public exposure, consistent SGs, cross-account peering, and Route53 delegated zones for control-plane discovery. This PR introduces reusable modules for subnets (public/private/isolated), interface and gateway endpoints (S3, ECR, SecretsManager, KMS, EC2), security group templates for control-plane services, automated VPC peering and route propagation helpers, and Route53 delegation/peering records. The change includes examples for single-AZ and multi-AZ installs, docs updates, CI validation, and a rollback/upgrade note. Testing: validated with terraform plan/apply in staging account, terratest integration for peering and endpoint connectivity, and e2e DNS resolution checks. Linear: ENG-4721. Related: PRs that add installer integration and Helm chart knobs will follow. Rollout plan: merge to main, cut release branch for the next Private installer, run upgrade tests during maintenance window, ship migration guide.
